## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a corrupted shared library file: `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/lib-dynload/_sqlite3.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so`. 

The ELF header of this file was damaged - the 4th byte was `0x40` instead of the correct `0x46`, making the file invalid. This caused an `ImportError` when Python tried to load the `_sqlite3` module, which is a core dependency used by pytest (via the `pytest-cov` plugin) and pandas.

The fix was to copy the valid `_sqlite3.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so` file from the conda package cache (`/opt/miniconda3/pkgs/python-3.10.18-h1a3bd86_0/lib/python3.10/lib-dynload/`) to the testbed environment, restoring the corrupted library to its original state.
